# Brief: ShelfSwap

## Product
A neighbourhood app where parents swap outgrown children's books.

## Audience & initial segment
Parents of children aged 3–8 in one district of Gdańsk (Wrzeszcz).

## Problem
Children outgrow books in months; parents keep boxes of books they cannot easily pass on.

## Register
| ID | Type | Statement | Source | Evidence level | Status | Date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-1 | F | 7 of 10 parents interviewed keep a box of outgrown books | interview notes, 2026-09-20 | stated intent | open | 2026-09-20 |
| A-1 | A | Parents will meet a stranger to swap books | test: 5 swap meetups via a local parents' group | — | open | 2026-09-20 |
| A-2 | A | A district has enough parents to make swaps quick | not testable now: needs a running pilot | — | open | 2026-09-20 |
| D-1 | D | Start with one district only | ADR-001 | — | accepted | 2026-09-22 |

## Change proposals
none

## Unknowns
- Whether parents prefer swapping or selling for a small fee.

## Conversation state
- Last topic: how to test A-1 cheaply.
- Settled: segment (parents of 3–8 year olds, Wrzeszcz); one district first (ADR-001).
- Open question for the user: are you willing to organise the first 5 meetups yourself?
